capabilities: Browse and search remote Pageden documents
Download remote folders and documents into the vault
Push local edits and resolve conflicts with versioned metadata
Import an existing vault into a Pageden workspace
Co-edit live documents via a shared Yjs/WebSocket room
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose sync tool; it only connects vaults to Pageden servers, not arbitrary storage or other services.
extras: Sends document content, metadata, attachments, and sync state to the configured Pageden server; supports self-hosted servers; live co-editing merges simultaneous edits and autosaves via the revision API; conflicts write the server copy as *.conflict.md without touching the local file.
problem: Teams whose Markdown documents live on a server cannot browse, edit, or keep those documents in sync with a local Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Connect an Obsidian vault to Pageden, a server-owned Markdown workspace for teams and AI agents

requires.name: Pageden workspace account with personal access token or device-code login

summary: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a Pageden server workspace, with remote browsing, search, vault import, and live co-editing.
